cs.t: That would be my multimeter - a Soar ME-540, like this one:  https://www.radiomuseum.org/r/soar_digital_multimeter_me_540...  Bought originally by my father, most likely when he was on contract in Kuwait in the 80s. It fell out of use as he stopped doing any sort of electrical work citing typical age-related issues. The battery cover is gone and the plastic body feels kind of loose, but otherwise it's fully functional(even if de-calibrated). The original fuse is still there, but I wouldn't use it for any high-voltage applications.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your oldest piece of electrical equipment?
